messages:
alex_csm: drafting a tiny customer one-pager called 'Warmwire' — focused on priming (prefill), modest batching, streaming early, and clear renewal signals. want a paste-ready config + 3 quick checks.

nina_sre: sounds good. keep hosted defaults conservative; include a circuit-breaker and a single warmup command.

tom_se: add a note for sensitive-data customers: skip broad prefill, only run targeted prompts.

kate_am: renewal signals we care about: engagement dip >25% in 48h, conversion drop >7% in first week, or sustained p95 >800ms -> AM outreach.

alex_csm: paste-ready hosted defaults (very short):

```yaml
warmwire:
  prefill: true
  prefill_window_h: 24
  batch:
    max_batch_size: 10
    max_wait_ms: 110
  streaming:
    enabled: true
    min_tokens: 6
  circuit_breaker:
    error_rate: 0.10
    cooldown_s: 300
```

nina_sre: one-line warmup ops command (copy/paste):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"hosted-small","input":"hello world","prefill":true}'
```

tom_se: telemetry to monitor day0-7: token/s, p95 latency, cache hit %, median batch size, streaming fallback %. target cache hit >60% after day1.

kate_am: handoff checklist (short): model & quant, expected RPM, 3 eval prompts + quality owner, renewal thresholds set, escalation contact.

alex_csm: quick triage lines: cache hit <40% -> check prefix keys/prefill jobs; p95 >900ms -> reduce batch size or lower max_wait_ms; error rate above CB -> open circuit-breaker and page oncall.
